0022600032.text: In this Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, the Trail Blazers (6-1) arrive as the top team in the Northwest and the West, riding a three-game win streak and a 5-0 road record, while the Lakers (7-2) lead the Pacific and sit second in the West on their own three-game streak. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), and Los Angeles is without Sandro Mamukelashvili, who is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 136-129 win in Los Angeles on October 27, and it also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
